paite: Kumpipa in TOUPA atu a, athupina in akithuam a; TOUPA ahatna a kithuam in atai ah akigakta hi; khovel leng alin theihlouhna ding in, hihkip in a-om hi.
heading: Pathian, Kumpipa

paite: Na laltutphah nidanglai a na hihkipsa ahi a, nang tangtawn a omsa na hi.
TOUPA aw, luipite'n a-aw uh asuah ua, luipite'n aging thupitak uh asuah uhi.
Tui tampi awte sang in, tuipi kihot hattakte sang in leng, tunglam a TOUPA ahatzaw hi.
Na thu theihsakte amuanhuai mahmah a; TOUPA aw, tangtawn in na inn sianthouna toh akilawm hi.
